versions.author: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.subject: Original Constitution 1973-08-14 Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.content:
| Title        | Constitution of Supreme Court.                                                              |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |

The Supreme Court shall consist of a Chief Justice to be known as the Chief Justice of Pakistan and so many other Judges as may be determined by Act of Parliament or, until so determined, as may be fixed by the President.

versions.author: Asif Ali Zardari
versions.subject: Twenty-seventh Amendment 2025-11-13 Asif Ali Zardari
versions.content:
| Title        | Constitution of Supreme Court.                                                              |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 13 November 2025                                                                            |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |
| Amendment 27 | https://www.senate.gov.pk/uploads/documents/1762598611_995.pdf |

The Supreme Court shall consist of a Chief Justice to be known as the Chief Justice of Supreme Court and so many other Judges as may be determined by Act of Parliament or, until so determined, as may be fixed by the President.
